dataset: FLIP2 Hydrophobic Core official to-P06241 split
interpretation: All three numerical transfer baselines show negative transfer on the frozen external protein-backbone target. The single online LLM decision matched GP rank one and then abstained, so it caused no online increment but prevented further source-conditioned actions. The LLM-generated initial design remained worse than the fixed design in this one trajectory.
claim_boundary: The classical effects are paired over 100 seeds. The online LLM effects are one prospective model trajectory and have no sampling confidence interval.
